title: Hotline Miami 2 datapack
description: Mandatory companion data pack for the Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number music resource pack that extends song duration limits so all tracks play in full without cutting off.

title: Feywild Higher Spawn Rates
description: This is a small datapack that will increase the spawn rates of Pixies, Bee Knights, Bellsnickels, Shroomlings and Mandragora of the Feywild Mod.

title: xDiscord
description: Minecraft-Discord linking plugin featuring a code system, player verification, and simple server integration.

title: Advanced Rocketry - Continuation
description: The 1.7.10 continuation version of Advanced Rocketry

title: Bonfires
description: Bonfires is a vanilla datapack for Minecraft that adds a simple fast-travel system using special campfires.

title: WGLocale
description: Modern multilingual localization and help layer for WorldGuard. Translates protection messages, supports per-player languages, and provides a clean modern interface for WorldGuard commands.

title: Quality Of Life Enchants
description:
QOL Enchants
QOL Enchants is a lightweight, high-performance plugin that adds three custom quality-of-life enchantments to your Minecraft survival experience. These are designed to make resource gathering smoother, faster, and more satisfying.
